$comment: Allowed tools for implementing and revision runs (claude-issues.yml, claude.yml), passed to the Action's `settings` input. Not .claude/settings.json: that file is read by every interactive session in a clone, and the deny list here would block /plan and /dispatch there (a deny wins over any allow at any level). In agent mode the Action grants no file tools, so Read/Edit/Write are listed. The list covers what .claude/prompts/*.md asks for and nothing else; /bootstrap adds the dev-server, migrate, seed, and screenshot commands by name when they exist. Any change here is an always-read PR. The deny list also names everything .claude/settings.json allows for the owner, because the CLI in the runner reads that file too and a deny here wins over an allow there.
